answer: In an agent marketplace for jade, umber pigment and canyon survey data, each seller must lock a $1,000 bond for 30 days before receiving one daily auction slot. Extra identities earn extra slots only if each posts its own bond; renaming an agent does not transfer an existing slot. An attacker running 500 sellers must immobilize $500,000, paying financing costs and losing access to that capital even if every bond is eventually returned.
